scope: Opt-in read-only stored AdamW moment observer; CPU mathematical and noninterference validation

focused_tests.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_optimizer_diagnostics.py
focused_tests.log_kind: Captured successful tool output, not a second test run

checks: Known moment arithmetic, strict epsilon-ratio bins, domain counts and energy-weighted attenuation.
Actual standard and foreach AdamW parameter updates, including decoupled weight decay, agree with FP64 moment formulas within FP32 tolerance.
Per-parameter stored step and group-specific betas/epsilon are respected; family summaries pool coordinates.
Different chunk sizes agree within FP64 roundoff; slicing precedes CPU conversion.
Parameters, gradients, moment values, counters, storage references, tensor versions, group settings, state membership and CPU/Python RNG remain unchanged.
Uninitialized state, stored zero moments and undefined zero-second-moment comparators stay distinct.
Unsupported, malformed or nonfinite state and duplicate membership are rejected.
limitations: No CUDA transfer/synchronization-overhead measurement or 9B observation has been performed.
Stored-moment formulas describe normalized adaptive directions; attenuation excludes learning rates, weight decay and native rounding.
A ratio indicating epsilon damping does not establish model-quality causation or justify changing epsilon.
Stored zeros do not establish zero gradient history; unsupported state variants are rejected explicitly.
Only an explicit future caller adds observations after selected completed optimizer updates.
